name: Wolve Loyalty
author: Wolve AI

sections.description:
Wolve is a loyalty platform plugin designed to help you easily reward your customers through an intuitive loyalty program. Enhance customer engagement and encourage repeat business by providing points, discounts, and exclusive offers.

Features:

  • Create and manage a comprehensive loyalty program
  • Reward points for purchases
  • Create coupons
  • Tiered Programs
  • Referrals
  • Integration with WooCommerce for seamless transactions
  • Track user activities and engagement with detailed reports in Wolve Platform

Short Description

Enhance customer engagement and retention with Wolve Loyalty. Reward shoppers with points, discounts, and exclusive offers. Enjoy seamless WooCommerce integration and in-depth analytics to drive repeat business and growth in sales.

How to Obtain Credentials to Connect Your Store

Reach out to our support and customer service team at post@wolve.ai, and they will provide you with an API key to connect your store.

How do I reward customers with loyalty points?

You can configure reward rules in the Wolve platform to define how many points customers earn based on their purchase total.

Does it integrate with WooCommerce?

Yes, Wolve Loyalty fully integrates with WooCommerce for seamless rewards distribution.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wolve-loyalty= directory, or install via the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Access the plugin settings via the newly created ‘Wolve Loyalty’ menu.
  4. Input the API key provided by our support team to connect your store and start using the loyalty program features.

screenshots.caption: Program Builder - Design your loyalty program in minutes. Choose a concept (points, tiers, stamp card, referrals), start from presets or fully customize rules, and layer on seasonal campaigns. Built for WordPress + WooCommerce—no code needed.

Email & SMS Integrations - Connect Klaviyo, Mailchimp and other tools to trigger automated flows from loyalty events (points earned, tier changes, win-backs). Enrich messages with member data and send targeted SMS directly from your stack.

AI Copilot & Insights - Always-on analysis turns store data into clear suggestions: new segments to target, perfectly timed campaigns, and next actions. Create audiences like “buys often but never redeems” with one click.
WooCommerce Setup - Paste your store URL and click Connect. The plugin installs cleanly, scales easily, and includes an optional free trial—so you can be live in minutes.

Shopper Experience (End-to-End) - Show points on product pages, give customers a My Loyalty page in their account, and let them redeem at checkout without leaving the flow. A complete earn-and-burn experience for WooCommerce.
Support - Fast, live support available 24/7 across time zones. Get help with onboarding, best-practice playbooks, and optimization whenever you need it.
